claims.paraphrase: Elevated valuation did not establish a bubble; investor psychology matters.
claims.limit: No fixed horizon or crash forecast.

claims.paraphrase: Wider credit spreads increased compensation as default risk also rose.
Expected to deploy the opportunistic debt fund faster given anticipated distress.
Assessment shifted from elevated valuations to greater concern; did not imply imminent correction.

claims.paraphrase: Transformative technology can attract excess investment that accelerates adoption while destroying some investor capital.
claims.limit: Technology adoption is distinct from investor return.

claims.paraphrase: Debt maturity, collateral obsolescence and cash-flow uncertainty can make infrastructure financing fragile.

claims.limit: Do not convert uncertainty into bearish score.

claims.paraphrase: Oaktree had made some data-center investments.
claims.limit: Unquantified self-report, not independently verified; no inferred return.

claims.paraphrase: AI technology may be genuine even if infrastructure investment becomes excessive.
claims.limit: Not a prediction of a crash date.

claims.paraphrase: AI may outperform in processing shared data; novel situations and qualitative judgment remain difficult.
claims.limit: Author judgment, not measured AI performance.

claims.paraphrase: Economic and portfolio dependence on AI creates vulnerability to adverse developments in one sector.
claims.limit: Author assessment; cited third-party statistics not independently admitted.

claims.paraphrase: Separate ability to forecast from position size and compensation for uncertainty.
claims.limit: Long-term deliberation, no fixed 6–12 month target.

claims.paraphrase: Continued preference for owning good businesses, including controlled and listed equity interests.
Marketable equity holdings declined; controlled equity interests remained substantially larger by stated value.
claims.limit: Statement of management, not independent market valuation.

contrasts.limit: Explicit retrospective comparison in August; dates/valuations change, not a directional return forecast.
Repeated author does not create independent evidence.
Different asset exposures, intention vs self-report, no proof the intended fund deployment occurred.
Listed equity sales can coexist with long-term ownership philosophy. No motive inferred.

behavior.limit: Cash plus short-term Treasury bills is gross of unsettled purchase payables, excludes other segment cash, not portfolio weight. Equity flow is consolidated, balance scope is Insurance and Other. Net sales are cash flow, not realized gains or changes in marked portfolio value. No individual security or return analyzed. 2022–23 comparative rows transcribed from 2024 report, not contemporaneous original releases.

archive.limit: Official compilation labeled 1990–2025, no page census completed; later retrospective anthology does not establish original release clock or complete usable sample.

candidate: Measure whether explicit changes in investor valuation assessment and financing mechanisms add information to matched numeric baselines. Require complete release census, source lineage, independent labels, fixed target/horizon and forward evaluation. No forecast score for philosophy/uncertainty/action.
